rebrew.schema.json is the dispatch contract shared with ai.relumea.app.backend-go,
which mirrors it byte-identically at contracts/dispatch/rebrew.schema.json
(generated there with `go run ./cmd/surface-tracker`). The metadata operations
(rebrew.metadata_describe, rebrew.metadata_diff, rebrew.metadata_carry, the
version 3 capture descriptor, the apply_candidate metadata and
attested_registry_digest fields), rebrew.project_targets, rebrew.vocabulary
(with placeholder_name), rebrew.check_cflags, rebrew.rename_identifier,
the top-level documents section (the .relumea/analysis-report.json shape) and
every op's timeout_seconds and interruptible (with the description's sentence
on them) were extended here first, and rebrew.coverage_export, rebrew.source_variants,
rebrew.decompme_export, rebrew.source_rename, rebrew.source_split and
rebrew.source_merge were removed here first (no caller; their source work is
rebrew.retained_source_operation); rebrew.import_archive is the entry the backend generates
from its rebrew.ImportArchive definition (branch fix-yc-reversed, commit "define
rebrew.import_archive"); the rest is the copy of backend commit
80314a46a1ae26d9ef3d56d90e1d454c561f5928.
SHA-256: 0f8ce890bc8d4f910aab7aa58a2e77e72533371cb13b0a907b637a02bf66cf8e.
tests/test_ops.py validates every op request and reply against it, the
analysis report rebrew.analyse captures against documents, and every op's
timeout_seconds and interruptible against rebrew.ops.OPS.
